description: Which other launch wallets share this deployer's funder? Serial ruggers launch each token from a fresh wallet funded from one source. Pass a deployer wallet or a token on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or Solana: returns the wallet that first funded it (exchanges, bridges and busy services flagged, never linked), the other deployers it funded, their tokens and how many lost their liquidity within a week, from our own launch records since 2026-10-23. Not advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

address.description: The deployer wallet, or a token address (then its deployer is looked up)

chain.description: Chain; defaults to solana for base58 addresses, otherwise base
